Team —

Quick one: finance needs a tight number for pipe-to-quota coverage for May close. We opened the weekend with a 1.6x coverage target but our run-rate shows a 1.2x coverage unless a few late deals convert. I want us to lock a final commit plan by EOD Thurs so FP&A can model the run-rate bridge.

Please do the following by EOD Tuesday (11 May):
- Owners update opportunity stage to the latest status in SFDC (don’t put "Proposal" if pricing not yet sent).
- Mark any deals where legal/procurement signoff is needed and estimate probability as 10/30/60 basis (use comments).
- Populate the attached coverage_model_may_v3.xlsx: column "Likely Commit" should be your pledge for May close.

I’ll compile and run the gap analysis on Wed, share variance waterfall and required micro-commits. If you see any risks that need leadership escalation, flag them to me and cc Laura.

Thanks — short responses welcome.

Dylan
